title: analyzing-canary-rollout input
description: ENFORCED — the engine validates this ASSEMBLED stage input against this schema BEFORE the stage runs (engine/validation.py validate_stage_input; fail-closed, engine/config/runtime-binding.yaml input_validation: enforce). Shape below is the POST-adapter payload delivered at stage canary-analysis.

receipt_id.description: Handoff receipt id from release-handoff; resolved through the read-only deployment registry to locate the live rollout, its canary/baseline split, and the approved metric definitions.

idempotency_key.description: engine-injected: the workflow's single idempotency key, injected into every stage payload (same key + same inputs => same output).

upstream_artifacts.description: engine-injected: map of producer stage id to its artifact path relative to this stage's dir (orchestrator.py). Present whenever the stage has from_stage inputs.

loop_back_feedback.description: engine-injected (conditional): reviewer findings threaded into a re-run after a loop_back; absent on first execution.
